Marissa / Aditya —

I reviewed the two indemnity points and the SLA exposure from a legal perspective. Quick notes:
- Mutual indemnity for IP claims: acceptable with our standard carve-outs (we should not accept broad third-party indemnity tied to customer-generated content without attribution). I will draft a narrow redline to propose mutual indemnity with the usual exclusions.
- Data breach carve-outs & liquidated damages: concerning if they seek expanded notification windows and uncapped liquidated damages. Recommend we push back on uncapped liability; if Acme insists, we can propose a capped exposure aligned to deal value (e.g., 1x–2x ARR) and standard notice timelines.

Timing: I can prepare a redline by EOD 2/24. If Sales wants to present a commercial path now, Aditya’s one-time 10% approval is fine for an initial pilot. For the full 20% and any elevated credit exposure on SLA, Legal needs to finalize redlines and Finance/CFO will need to sign off on capped liability.

Rishi Malhotra
Chief Legal Officer
rishi@redwood.ai
